LanguageData.PowerDiode.SharedGrid: Linked to {0}, but disabled: another connection somewhere else joins the two sides.
LanguageData.PowerDiode.MustPlaceNextToUnpairedDrawNo: Must be placed directly adjacent to an unpaired power diode intake.
LanguageData.PowerDiode.WattageCapTooltip: The maximum wattage this outlet will feed to its network. It never feeds more than this, and never more than its paired intake's network currently has to spare.
LanguageData.PowerDiode.ReserveTooltip: How much stored energy (in watt-days) to keep untouched in batteries on the intake's network. As their total stored energy nears this amount, this outlet feeds less than its wattage cap; once it's reached, batteries are treated as if they have nothing left to give.
LanguageData.PowerDiode.ReservePercentTooltip: How much of the intake network's total battery capacity to keep untouched, as a percentage. As their total stored energy nears this share of capacity, this outlet feeds less than its wattage cap; once it's reached, batteries are treated as if they have nothing left to give.
LanguageData.PowerDiode.Mode.OneWayValve.Desc: Feeds power whenever the intake network has surplus power (or partially-charged batteries) to spare, up to the wattage cap, while keeping a battery reserve untouched on the intake side.
LanguageData.PowerDiode.Mode.Overflow.Desc: Only feeds power once the intake network's batteries are charged above a set percentage. Below that it stays off; above it, it feeds up to the wattage cap.
LanguageData.PowerDiode.Mode.TopUp.Desc: Only feeds power while the outlet network's batteries are below a set percentage, and stops once they reach it.
LanguageData.PowerDiode.OverflowThresholdTooltip: Only feed power once the intake network's batteries are charged above this percentage of their total capacity. Flow ramps down smoothly as their charge approaches the threshold from above, and stops once it's reached.
LanguageData.PowerDiode.TopUpThresholdTooltip: Only feed power while the outlet network's batteries are charged below this percentage of their total capacity. Flow ramps down smoothly as their charge approaches the threshold, and stops once it's reached.
LanguageData.PowerDiode.Settings.ReserveIsPercentage: Set battery reserve as a percentage
LanguageData.PowerDiode.Settings.ReserveIsPercentageT: When enabled, the battery reserve slider on one-way valve outlets is set as a percentage of the intake network's total battery capacity instead of an absolute amount of watt-days.
